newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Unibank to float 70 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Unibank to float 70 million shares.

text.p: Indonesia's PT United City Bank (Unibank) said on Tuesday it will raise 47.25 billion rupiah from its planned flotation of 70 million shares next week.
Unibank said in an announcement that it will offer each share at a price of 675 rupiah during the three-day initial public offering period from May 12-14.
The bank will be listed on the Jakarta Stock Exchange on June 6.
The bank said it had no intention of proposing a rights issue or list new shares for the next 12 months.

It said about half the proceeds would be used to broaden its loan base, around 20 percent to expand its branches, about 25 percent to improve information systems while the remaining five percent would be allocated for human resources development.
